wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A carries NO transaction. On the first writing line the filer drew a nil mark in the Name-of-Contributor column (a zero flanked by short strokes, i.e. '-0-') and a matching '0' in the Amount column, leaving Date and Mailing Address empty. That is a nil marker for the whole schedule, not a row: there is no donor, no date, and a $0 contribution from nobody is not a transaction. Treated as an EMPTY SCHEDULE (transcribed, zero rows) with the glyphs recorded here verbatim. It closes against cover line 1, which reads 0 in all three columns, so the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: Form B carries the same nil marker on its first writing line — a '0' in the 'To Whom Expenditure was made' column and a '0' in the Amount column, Date and Purpose empty — and no transaction anywhere on the page. Zero rows sum 0.00, which equals cover line 3 THIS REPORT (0). It does NOT equal the cumulative 200, so this side is on the PERIOD scope: the cycle's 200 of expenditures was reported earlier and is not itemised in this document.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr form prints no page subtotal and no schedule total on either schedule; cover lines 1 and 3 are the only anchors, and both close.
gates.row_count: Both p2 and p3 carry exactly ONE inked band each — the first writing line, holding only the nil markers described above — and zero transaction rows were emitted from either. Verified by reading both pages full-page at 200 dpi and then re-reading the top band of each at 600 dpi (x=0 y=480 W=5100 H=400), which shows the '-0-' / '0' pair in the name and amount columns with empty date and address cells.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable — zero rows emitted on both sides. (The nil markers are deliberately not given geometry, because emitting a pointer would imply a row exists.)
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY: 0 (line 1 cum) + 0 (line 2 cum) - 200 (line 3 cum) = -200, and cover line 4 CUMULATIVE reads '(200)' — accounting parentheses, i.e. negative 200. The LAST and THIS balance cells are blank.

escalation_note: 600 dpi top-band crops of p2 and p3 (x=0 y=480 W=5100 H=400) to establish that the marks on the first writing line of each schedule are nil markers in the name/amount columns with empty date and address cells, and not a faint transaction.
